liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (2 reviews): Going from Looks Like Rain into Deal mid-second set caused mayhem; dosed fans panicked about the time before drums; Reviewer thinks Deal works well as the vehicle into drums and space [17][22]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer's highlight; rumored Dylan rehearsals made the crowd go wild when the band launched into this edgy rocker; Uploader notes this as the first time the band played it [2][19]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Reviewer likes the idea of Bucket leading into Franklin's Tower [16]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Jerry forgot the lyrics before 'let the music play'; reviewer finds it a bare-bones typical 1987 version [20]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer finds it decent but never overpowering, wanting more bad-boy edge from Bobby's vocal [20]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer counts this among their favorite versions of the song [22]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Phil boomed into it just as the reviewer was dragged out in handcuffs [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-20.146928.senn441.corso-rossi.ford.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 139 min [1]
- **gd1987-06-20.135308.bltz.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader says cardioid heads would have been better, since shotguns focused on too small a section of the stack at the small Greek [2]
- **gd1987-06-20.akg414.bryant.gems.77988.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 142 min [3]. Said about its sound: Balloon pops were reduced; light static throughout, with some at the end of disc 1 track 4 and in the second space [3]
- **gd1987-06-20.mtx.dts.haugh.93386.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 141 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd87-06-20.sbd.clugston.11943.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 131 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard's static unbearable and says better-sounding shows are available; Reviewer says the static on this soundboard gives the show a unique character; Soundboard lacks the odd voices and samples Healy added, which the reviewer's FM copy has [15][22][23]

## Around the show

- Tickets were very hard to get; Jerry's clean, fired-up condition was the talk of that spring and summer [13]
- First set was only six songs, with just three before space, which would have worried attendees [16]
- Reviewer calls the Greek a beautiful venue, and says the show cooked throughout [19]
- Jerry forgot lyrics, while the crowd's energy gave him a huge contact high; reviewer calls it a magical shared experience [21]
- The encore One More Saturday Night is misplaced in the setlist; Healy's weird samples came before it on the FM copy [23]
- Reviewer was beaten and arrested by UC Berkeley police during the second set, dragged out as The Other One began [24]
- Jerry looked and played strikingly different from the previous summer, when he seemed unwell, rested on the mic and avoided high notes [13]
- Reviewer calls the stretch leading to drums the best they had witnessed before Drums/Space [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-20.146928.senn441.corso-rossi.ford.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Transferred and mastered by Alex Ford; source: Source: MAC; Sennheiser 441s(left of board) > Sony D5 > Maxell XLII90 + Maxell MX90 [1]. Also: Master cassettes from Mark McCue's collection were used to patch the Space tape flip after Watchtower [1]
- **gd1987-06-20.135308.bltz.flac24**: taped by bltz; transferred by bltz; source: Source: Previously unreleased Cassette original master. Nakamichi CM-300s/CP4 Shotguns -> Sony Walkman Pro/ (Triad Metal-Position MG-X 90 for Set 1 and Maxell… [2]. Also: Uploader's own early master tape, made with brand-new equipment and no experience, part of an Original Master Rescue Project [2]
- **gd1987-06-20.akg414.bryant.gems.77988.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Robert Bryant; transferred by Rich Gastwirt and Bob Looy; source: AKG 414 B/TL mics, cardioid pattern with windscreens, ORTF-> Oade PS-> Sony PCM F1 [3]. Also: Static in the second space was treated with Waves X-Crackle; the soundboard is cut too, offering only five extra seconds [3]
- **gd1987-06-20.mtx.dts.haugh.93386.flac16**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD/AUD Matrix Mix [6]. Also: Soundboard transfer chain: PCM 601 to Sony DAT to Soundforge and Samplitude, with X-Crackle, to FLAC, by Charlie Miller; Audience source taped by Robert Bryant with AKG 414 mics in ORTF; transferred by Rich Gastwirt, edited by Bob Loy; Another source used Nakamichi CM304 mics into a Sony D5M, taped at nine feet in the stand [6]
- **gd87-06-20.sbd.clugston.11943.sbefail.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette> DAT> CDR [9]
